JOINT_WEXP_EMILIA_COMPARISON.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE for every case lacking native EMILIA output
JOINT_WEXP_EMILIA_COMPARISON.why: A joint comparison needs both parties' native outputs. For these five cases only the WEXP side produced one, and no frozen INTEROP-002 procedure produces the other.
JOINT_WEXP_EMILIA_COMPARISON.why_not_derived: Their EMILIA native outputs come from INTEROP-001, a different experiment identity carrying assurance class IA-0 in that package's own adapter. Deriving INTEROP-002 case-level relations from them is new comparison work that this order does not authorize and that section 4 of this order's prohibitions point away from. The values are reported below as an observed correspondence, not as a derived relation.

standing_prohibition.statement: An available verifier implementation is NOT a frozen execution procedure.
consequences: The EMILIA verifier is NOT run.
Availability of an implementation never converts into an execution record.
This prohibition survives publication and applies to any successor work under this experiment identity.

F-01_PRESERVED_WITH_CONTRIBUTOR_PRECISIO.the_substantive_gap_that_remains: The frozen charter presupposes a native output from each system - section 10 step 5, section 11.1 item 3, section 16 - yet section 16 never asks the contributor for one and no frozen INTEROP-002 procedure produces one for the five INTEROP-002-specific cases. B-01 in particular has none and no defined way to obtain one. This is a genuine experiment-design finding and is published as such.

B01_P1_RELATIONSHIP.the_observation: The four fields of the contributor's precommitted B-01 expectation - valid false, lifecycle_state indeterminate, outcome null, error outcome_observations_not_exactly_bound - are field-for-field the frozen INTEROP-001 native result for P-1.
B01_P1_RELATIONSHIP.why_anti_tuning: The blind case and its expectation are anchored in EMILIA's OWN previously recorded behaviour on an exact-binding failure, recorded on 2026-08-21, before the INTEROP-002 bridge existed in reviewable form and without the contributor seeing the bridge candidate bytes. The expectation was therefore not reverse-engineered from the bridge, and the bridge - authored blind to B-01 - was not tuned to the case. Neither side was fitted to the other.
B01_P1_RELATIONSHIP.why_semantic_precedent: EMILIA's refusal token for a not-exactly-bound observation is not invented for this experiment; it is the token its verifier already emitted for that condition. The WEXP bridge's BE-04 refusal on operation_id lands on the same condition through the EP section 6 conjunction.
B01_P1_RELATIONSHIP.LIMITATION: It does NOT constitute an EMILIA execution of B-01.
further_limitations: It is not a native output for B-01 and must never be presented as one.
It does not make the joint comparison for B-01 conclusive; B-01 remains INCONCLUSIVE at the joint scope.
The correspondence on attributed cause remains partly BY CONSTRUCTION, because BE-04 was deliberately built on EP section 6. That caveat was recorded before execution and is not withdrawn.
